description: SPIKE (depth>=2 bend-chain unfold) model: a PARALLEL chain (a Z / offset). Same 40x30 base + F1 (leg 25) as the corner case, but F2 (leg 15) folds off F1's TOP FREE edge (bend axis +X, PARALLEL to B1) rather than a side edge. Still depth 2 (F2 folds off the already-moved F1, not the base) but develops as a 1D strip. Built via two shipped build_edge_flange folds (tests/_bend_chain_builder.py, kind='parallel'). Proves the recursion also covers the parallel chain the shipped depth-1 unfold defers (docs/design/sheet-metal.md sec 4.3).
